candidate.title: SCRB-Seq
candidate.scope: The single SCRB-Seq (single-cell RNA barcoding and sequencing) route depicted by the assigned Illumina schematic, clarified at architecture level by Soumillon et al., bioRxiv 10.1101/003236 (2014). It represents well-separated single-cell poly(A)+ mRNA barcoding, cDNA pooling and an amplified 3′-expression library. The left single-cell-to-highlighted-RNA vignette is a title/assay overview, not a second workflow. There are no depicted alternatives, retained branches, droplets or beads. Nextera XT in the catalogue is a downstream preparation component, not another target method. The synthesis captions are retained with explicit primary-source corrections; this graph is not the complete chronological laboratory protocol.
